title: Zircon Skyeband lifts the heart with new single “Must Be Feeling In Love”
htmlContent: In their new single, Must Be Feeling In Love, Zircon Skyeband offers a bright tribute to the instant love that first kicks in when the world has a slightly warmer glow, the air feels a little less thick, and everything has fallen into place. Must Be Feeling In Love wastes no time pulling you in from its opening bars. The melody is infectious, the sort that lingers, not because it insists on your attention but because it deserves it.” The way the song unfolds feels effortless naturally, giving off comfortable and new warmth. The lyrics are honest, earnest, and relatable to the song’s marrow. Zircon Skyeband has a talent for capturing emotion without trying to do too much with it, and Must Be Feeling In Love is a shining example of that talent. The lyrics read like pages ripped from a private diary, revealing hushed revelations and intimate admissions. That moment when you catch yourself mid-thought, smile, and say to yourself, “Oh... this might be real.” But it is not only the songwriting that shines. A sense of craftsmanship forms into every layer of this single. The production is tight and tasteful, leaving range for every piece to breathe while fitting into a unified sound. https://open.spotify.com/track/7ma0Gnfglkni2j6upN5rfe From the invisible lift in the chorus to the seamless transitions and just the right amount of instrumentation, Must Be Feeling In Love shows that Zircon Skyeband doesn’t simply write songs, they craft experiences. It’s not a love song that’s sugar and not soul. There is a groundedness to it, a realness that accepts vulnerability as a part of the joy. You feel the passion in every note, and that tension between the two is what makes this song hit so hard. With Must Be Feeling In Love, Zircon Skyeband provides the score for that first heart-flip moment.
